authority: Cambridge International AS & A Level Computer Science 9618 syllabus, 2027-2029, Version 2

records.resolution: Keeps abstraction as both a reasoned filtering skill and a production task: the student must retain essential details, justify exclusions and produce an abstract model.
Connects decomposition to named program modules and introduces the required procedure/action and function/returned-value distinction without replacing later interface teaching.
Defines an algorithm as a solution to a problem expressed as a sequence of defined steps and rejects vague activity labels as a complete algorithm.
Requires meaningful identifier names and a table containing identifier, data type and purpose that matches the designed solution.
Uses input-process-output as a connected design for a complete pseudocode solution, with worked, practice, assessment and visual evidence.
Directly teaches and combines sequence, selection and iteration/repetition, and assesses the behaviour that selects each construct.
Covers structured English, flowcharts and pseudocode plus every required conversion direction while preserving inputs, outputs and control flow.
Develops a high-level algorithm through repeated refinement until each step is implementable, with clear module inputs and outputs and a preserved parent purpose.
Teaches construction and interpretation of comparison/Boolean logic statements used in decisions, loop conditions and Boolean assignments; tracing is supporting evidence, not substitute teaching.
Replaces a generic completeness-check question with a direct four-mark definition and boundary test for algorithm versus vague processing instruction.
Adds an independent quiz form for the official algorithm definition and meaningful identifier choice without changing the ten-mark quiz total, five-lesson mapping or overall assessment counts.
Replaces the generic scenario-analyser screenshot with a deterministic 1536x1024 explanation of high-level task, repeated refinement, implementable modules and the procedure/function boundary.
Adds a Section 9 checkpoint that reviews all nine requirements without substituting tracing, Java syntax or generic planning advice for the named core content.
